paragraphs.text:
After creating your character,
select a mission by rolling d6 on
the Mission Table. This will give you
a general goal to accomplish.
When you complete that mission,
you will receive the listed rewards.
If your character survives, you will
continue to play this character in
future missions. If s/he dies, you
will have to create a new one. The
final Campaign goal is to close 7
hell gates. Once that is done (this
will happen over the course of
multiple missions), you win the
game.
